cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Soup! You're finally using the recipe I taught you. I'll cook your dinners for a week in return.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer; please just rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole freezer. Nearly as thorough as your teacher. When I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just give the tubs back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Full tubs, then, and I'll buy you a bigger freezer. You learned generosity from me; I'd better give you somewhere to put the next lesson.

reason: Make A appropriate B care as taught generosity and respond to every reduction of need by enlarging its own gift to preserve the teacher lead.
